title: Figure 8. A Stargate in Times Square (photo-illustration)
description: Color street photograph of a crowded Times Square, New York, with billboards and pedestrians, digitally composited with a large spherical portal showing a desert scene and a bare tree. Caption reads "Figure 8. A Stargate in Times Square". Text below begins section "III. The General Relativistic Definition of Exotic Matter and the Energy Conditions".
